sources.title: Spring Framework — Mapping Requests
notes: Request Mapping section: method-specific shortcut annotations and URI path variables

sources.title: Spring Framework — @RequestBody
supports: @Valid DTO with field constraints, default 400 validation error
notes: Method Argument @RequestBody: HttpMessageConverter, validation and default error handling

sources.title: Spring Framework — ResponseEntity
supports: Return HTTP status and Location header separately from the DTO body
notes: Return Value ResponseEntity: status, headers and body; status choices in lesson are an explicit API design

sources.title: Spring Framework — @RequestParam
notes: Method Argument @RequestParam: binds Servlet request parameters including query strings

sources.title: Spring Framework — @RequestHeader
notes: Method Argument @RequestHeader: binds request header values to method arguments

claims.statement: Spring MVC supports method-specific mapping annotations such as @PostMapping and @GetMapping, including class-level shared request paths.
claims.rationale: The Spring MVC reference documents composed HTTP method annotations and a class-level @RequestMapping example.

claims.statement: The @PathVariable annotation binds values captured from a mapped URL path into handler method arguments.
claims.rationale: The official MVC reference shows captured URI variables passed as method parameters.

claims.statement: Spring MVC uses an HttpMessageConverter to read and deserialize an @RequestBody argument into a Java object.
claims.rationale: The official reference documents deserialization into a target object through registered converters.

claims.statement: With configured Bean Validation and field constraints, @Valid @RequestBody validation errors produce a 400 response by default.
claims.rationale: The reference explicitly describes validation and the default 400 response for invalid request bodies.

claims.statement: ResponseEntity allows a Spring MVC controller to choose HTTP status and response headers in addition to a serialized response body.
claims.rationale: Spring MVC describes ResponseEntity as status-plus-headers-plus-body, enabling a thin HTTP mapping layer.

claims.statement: Spring MVC @RequestParam can bind a query-string parameter to a typed controller argument.
claims.rationale: The reference covers query and form request parameter binding with automatic conversion.

claims.statement: Spring MVC @RequestHeader can bind a named HTTP request header to a controller method argument.
claims.rationale: The official documentation shows typed request header binding.
